name: The Vanishing Grove
introDiscord:
The grove ahead seems incomplete. Roots fade into moss, moss fades
into fish, and several entire pieces of scenery disappear when viewed
from the wrong angle.
introTwitch:
The grove ahead seems incomplete. Roots fade into moss, moss fades
into fish, and several entire pieces of scenery disappear when viewed
from the wrong angle.

the-vanishing-grove-approach.prompt:
Three paths pass through veilmoss so perfectly camouflaged that even
the routes seem uncertain about whether they exist.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp conceals a Star Candy cache.

You only notice it because the moss covering it blinks.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool rests beside Shizuki's sign:

'POOL IS HERE.

Writing this because I lost it twice.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the pool where it is. Hopefully it remains there.

forward.message:
A section of the grove opens one eye.

Then another.

The 'root wall' detaches itself and becomes a Veilmoss Grouper.

the-vanishing-grove-depths.prompt:
Moonlit fronds surround three corridors whose landmarks disappear
whenever you turn around.

left.message:
A familiar-looking mossy stone from the previous chamber swims past.

It was a Grouper the entire time.

Excellent.

right.message:
One Berry sits beneath Shizuki's landmark sign:

'BIG ROCK.

VERY IMPORTANT LANDMARK.'

There is no rock.

A note below adds:

'Rock left.'

forward.message:
A shrine coffer is completely invisible beneath mirror-moss until your
hand bumps the latch.

Very secure.

Mostly by accident.

the-vanishing-grove-threshold.prompt:
Towering kelp frames Mirror-Moss Hollow. Three final routes blend into
walls that look almost identical.

left.message:
An offering basket hidden inside a root appears only in reflection.
Inside are Star Candies and Shizuki's tiny note:

'Found this by walking into wall.'

right.message:
Nothing blocks the path.

Then the nothing develops teeth.

forward.message:
Restorative sap sits beneath a bright ribbon Shizuki tied around the
bottle.

'Could not find medicine.

Made medicine easier to find.

Evolution.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the extremely visible bottle exactly where it is.

boss-antechamber.name: Mirror-Moss Hollow
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The Hollow looks empty.

Every smaller Grouper has disappeared.

You are absolutely certain that means nothing good.

bossPromptDiscord:
Mirror-moss reflects an empty chamber.

Then one reflection moves.

A huge section of the forest behind you is suddenly missing from the
reflection entirely.

Something enormous has been standing there the whole time.

Use /yes to enter Mirror-Moss Hollow or /no to leave before the scenery
tries anything else.
bossPromptTwitch:
Mirror-moss reflects an empty chamber.

Then one reflection moves.

A huge section of the forest behind you is suddenly missing from the
reflection entirely.

Something enormous has been standing there the whole time.

Use !yes to enter Mirror-Moss Hollow or !no to leave before the scenery
tries anything else.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat while carefully refusing to trust any object larger than a
Berry.

boss.revealText:
The moss-covered wall opens an enormous jaw.

Unseen Grovejaw reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Unseen Grovejaw fades back into the forest.

Within seconds, you cannot tell where it went.

You leave promptly."
